settings.name: code-review
settings.title: Review Proposed Code
settings.description: Checks pasted code with existing guards, grids and atoms auditors. Reports findings separately from execution success; saves scratch evidence without changing project source.

settings.name: file
settings.title: Intended file
settings.description: Project-relative filename, such as src/components/Card/Card.tsx or src/atoms/action.css. Review does not change this file.

settings.name: code
settings.title: Proposed code
settings.description: Paste the exact code to check. Static checks only; this code is never executed. Maximum 256 KiB combined with supporting CSS.

settings.name: css
settings.title: Supporting CSS (optional)
settings.description: CSS for resolving class-based grid/flex layout in JSX. Only the grids check reads this; it is not written to the project.

settings.name: checks
settings.title: Check groups
settings.description: Omit for all groups, or supply an array such as ["guards","grids"] or ["atoms"]. Non-applicable groups are reported as skipped.
